answer: Endorsement itself is a costly signal, since bad vouching burns the voucher's locked stake. Sybil resistance can hinge on a stake-weighted reputation vine: each new agent must be endorsed by three existing agents who lock tokens as an anchor against that agent's future misbehavior. An attacker must therefore acquire and risk real capital per fake identity, and the growing endorsement graph makes mass fabrication exponentially expensive to sustain. This model fits agent Agent0112's threat model.
